description: This file contains utility functions related to password management in a SuiteCRM environment. It includes functions for checking email capabilities for sending passwords and verifying if a user's password has expired, integrating with SuiteCRM's configuration and user management.

classes.name: SugarPHPMailer
classes.description: Class used for sending emails via different mailing protocols within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving bean objects in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: user
classes.description: Represents user entities within SuiteCRM, including retrieving user IDs and data.

classes.name: timedate
classes.description: Provides date and time manipulation functions used throughout SuiteCRM.

methods.name: canSendPassword
methods.description: Checks if the current system is configured properly for sending password emails, and returns relevant error messages if not.

methods.name: hasPasswordExpired
methods.description: Determines whether a specific user's password has expired based on system settings and user activity.
